questions.stem: Why is excretion essential for maintaining homeostasis?

options.text: It supplies oxygen to cells for aerobic respiration
It removes toxic metabolic waste that would otherwise disrupt the internal environment
It provides energy for cells to carry out their functions
It transports nutrients from the digestive system to cells

questions.explanation: Excretion removes toxic metabolic waste products like carbon dioxide and urea from the body. If these substances accumulate, they disrupt enzyme function, change blood pH, and damage cells, preventing the body from maintaining a stable internal environment.
